body_markdown:
### For Kids


-


##### Simple, Screen-Free Calling


Get unlimited low-cost calling to friends and family with no contracts.


-


##### Trusted Circle


Allow only the people in your inner circle to reach you, and block those you don’t want to hear from.


-


##### Party Line


Have fun chatting with more than one friend or family member using the three-way calling line.


-


##### Listen to Voicemails Again


Built-in answering machine preserves messages from grandparents and other loved ones.


### For Parents


-


##### Safe & Sound


Address-based 911 lets first responders know your registered address and notifies emergency contacts.*


-


##### Scheduled Quiet Hours


Keep kids focused and unplugged during homework, bedtime, or playtime.


-


##### Call Log


Monitor all incoming, outgoing and missed calls online at any time.


-


##### Easy Setup


Connect through Wi‑Fi or hardwire to your router and start making calls in 15 minutes or less.
